numeric_missing_strategy: Training-fold median + missing indicators; scaling fitted within fold
categorical_strategy: Training-fold most frequent + one-hot; unknown ignored

model_settings.forest: 160 trees, min_samples_leaf=8, max_features=sqrt, no class weighting

cv: 5 stratified folds x 3 repeats, no tuning; per-device mean OOF prediction
ci: 1000 stratified device bootstraps conditional on fixed mean OOF scores
top120: Stable descending score order; tied scores use workbook row order. No top120 metric for non-ranking baseline.
